entries.03b492154038963e: This is the core business of the group, selling medical devices (equipment and consumables) purchased from domestic medical device manufacturers, distributors and trading companies to medical facilities such as hospitals in Japan. It also repairs medical devices it has sold and provides maintenance for medical devices in general under maintenance contracts. In addition, it provides ASP services for medical materials purchasing and inventory management software to medical facilities, medical materials dealers and SPD operators. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥296,023 million, accounting for about 98% of the group's total.
